settings.heading: The right yak chew for your Boxer.
settings.subheading: Boxers are playful, energetic chewers with strong jaws and a tendency toward boredom-driven destruction. A yak chew channels that energy into productive calm time.
settings.estimate_note: Boxers (50–80 lbs) are moderate-to-strong chewers. Most need a Large. Their playful nature means they sometimes toss the chew around before settling into a gnaw session.
settings.card_1_text: Most Boxers weigh 50–80 lbs. A Large yak chew is the right starting point. If your Boxer is over 75 lbs or chews aggressively, consider XL for longer sessions.
settings.card_2_text: Boxers are notorious for destroying things when bored. A yak chew before you leave the house gives them a focused task. Pair with a calm cue word for best results.
settings.card_3_title: Safe for their unique jaw structure
settings.card_3_text: Boxers have a brachycephalic jaw (undershot bite). Yak chews work well because dogs grip them with side teeth. The rectangular shape is easier for Boxers to hold than round toys.
